# Copilot instructions

**Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before writing code — it is the authoritative and only set of conventions for this repo.**

It covers the non-negotiables (WordPress VIP compatibility, WordPress coding standards, minimal documentation, a changelog entry per PR), file and class structure, fully-qualified class references, autoloading, test commands, and the Cypress `@group` / `@covers` convention (**never run the full Cypress suite** — it takes 20+ minutes).

Conventions live in that file only. Don't add them here.
